description: Benin-substations is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. This dataset was developed by KTH-dESA. It contains power substations in Benin based on data extracted from Open Street Map data (© OpenStreetMap contributors and Geofabrik GmbH). Coverage: Benin. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
